 Ulta Expansion Follows Walmart Entry As LG Household Pushes Rice Water Lines In K-Beauty Market The Face Shop, LG Household & Health Care’s cosmetics brand, has entered the online and offline channels of major U.S. retailer Ulta Beauty.
 LG Household & Health Care_The Face Shop Rice Water (provided by LG Household & Health Care)  
 The Face Shop began with a pre-launch on Ulta Beauty’s online mall in October and completed its rollout to about 500 offline stores early this month. Following its successful entry into Walmart in the United States in July, the brand has consecutively secured key local distribution networks. The products introduced through this latest launch are nine flagship items, including the bestselling 'Rice Water Bright' cleansing line and the new skincare line 'Rice Water Ready'.
 Its flagship Rice Water Bright line has continued to gain popularity in global markets based on product competitiveness that reinterprets traditional Korean beauty methods. In particular, Rice Water cleansing foam was selected as the best foam cleanser in the skincare category at the '2026 Allure Best of Beauty Awards' in September. The Face Shop plans to extend this reputation in cleansing into the basic skincare segment.
 The newly introduced Rice Water Ready line is specialized for “skin prep,” designed to condition the skin before makeup. It contains ingredients derived from domestically produced rice and emphasizes moisturizing and radiance-enhancing effects. Key products include the 'Glowy Glazing Serum', which creates a glass-like skin effect, the gel-textured 'Glowy Essence Jelly Mist', and the 'Glowy Lip Serum', which helps moisturize the lips.
 The brand is also pursuing structural improvements for innovation. Marking the 20th anniversary of the Rice Water line this year, it fully renewed its package design, and last year it focused on diversifying products by launching the 'Milk and Jelly Double Cleansing Foam', which addresses the inconvenience of double cleansing. In June, it also introduced Rice Water Ready in advance through Amazon North America to gauge market response.
 The Face Shop plans to use its Ulta Beauty launch as a springboard to spread its distinctive K-beauty routine to local customers.
